hook: A floppy drive becomes a Wi-Fi NAS
hookText: A floppy drive becomes a Wi-Fi NAS

beats.say: Floppy3.5 is a 3.5-inch floppy disk portable Wi-Fi NAS, built to read old disks and share them over a network.
Its screen maps the disk's 80 cylinders as four rows of 20 columns, so you can see the whole disk at a glance.
Setup is a firmware flash: copy the file to the controller's USB drive, then build and flash the ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi firmware.
